description: BUG-09: PATHISH's lookbehind excluded [\w./] but not `$`, so a match started right after the sigil and reported the variable name as the first directory segment - `scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/...` from a wrapper script. The base of such a path is a runtime value, so no reading of it is checkable. A genuine bare path on the next line is still reported, so excluding the sigil did not blind the scan.
